load_current_user.what: Fills the user field with the user logged in to the pipeline.
examples: Click it to see only the assets assigned to you.
Load it on a shared machine so tasks show under your name.
load_current_user.details: star.entities.User.find_current(); without the studio pipeline it stays empty.

autorig_button.tip: Auto rig the chosen asset in a new scene.
autorig_button.what: Opens a new scene and builds the auto rig for the asset and show picked in the lists.
steps: Turn on extra scales if needed.
examples: Pick the asset "Boar", click Auto Rig and wait for the build.
Rig a batch of background props one after another.
autorig_button.details: New scene, then core02.build_auto_rig(asset, show, skin=False, scale_multiply=0.75, extra_scales). Skin is not loaded: load or paint it after.

autorig_current_button.tip: Auto rig the asset open in this scene.
autorig_current_button.what: Builds the auto rig on the asset that is already open, without opening a new scene.
examples: Open the model file, click it to rig what you have open.
Fix the model in the scene and rig it again without reopening it.
autorig_current_button.details: core02.build_auto_rig(rig_current_scene=True, skin=False, scale_multiply=0.75) on what is already open.

create_rig_sid.what: Creates the SID node that identifies the rig for the pipeline and the animation tools.
examples: Click it on a rig made by hand so Select Ctrls and the anim tools find it.
Add it to an old rig so AnimLoader Select Ctrls works on it.
create_rig_sid.details: core02.create_sid_node(): the SID lists the rig parts that the pipeline and AnimLoader read.

create_base_only.tip: Create only the base rig groups.
create_base_only.what: Makes the Mutant base hierarchy (Global ctrl and groups) without building any block.
examples: Use it when you want to rig a prop by hand inside the Mutant structure.
Start a vehicle rig by hand with the Mutant Global / Mover ctrls.
create_base_only.details: mt.check_is_there_is_base(): makes the Base block / Global ctrl hierarchy only if it does not exist.
